## Ctx.handleCaptionArgsAudio() method

Route function for `handleCaptionArgsAudio` with arg match intent `this.data.name`

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
handleCaptionArgsAudio?(): Promise<unknown>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by audio with caption and with arg.

## Example

this.data.name = "start 123 aaa" &amp;&amp; this.msg?.audio

```typescript
async handleCaptionArgsAudio() {
  this.msg?.audio // {...}
```
